name: vscode-l2m-agent
description: Interactive VS Code coding and data analytics agent backed by L2M webhook workflows.

l2mAgent.apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the L2M API server.

l2mAgent.workflowId.description: Optional workflow ID to execute. Leave empty to select by l2mAgent.webhookPath.

l2mAgent.webhookPath.description: Webhook input path used when workflowId is empty.

l2mAgent.authToken.description: Bearer API key for authenticated L2M API calls.

l2mAgent.streamResponses.description: Use the streaming webhook endpoint when sending prompts.

l2mAgent.requestTimeoutMs.description: Client-side timeout, in milliseconds, for L2M requests.

l2mAgent.maxContextChars.description: Maximum approximate text characters to include in each L2M context bundle.

l2mAgent.maxFileChars.description: Maximum text characters to include from any single active or pinned file snippet.

l2mAgent.maxGitDiffChars.description: Maximum text characters to include from git diffs.

l2mAgent.maxDiagnostics.description: Maximum VS Code diagnostics to include in each request.

l2mAgent.maxOpenEditors.description: Maximum open text editor tabs to include in each request.

l2mAgent.maxPinnedFiles.description: Maximum pinned file contents to include in each request.

l2mAgent.nearbyLineCount.description: Number of lines around the current selection or cursor to include from the active file.

l2mAgent.recentTurnCount.description: Number of recent chat turns to send in full before older turns are summarized into compacted memory.

l2mAgent.maxCompactedMemoryChars.description: Maximum characters retained in local compacted session memory.
